summary: Swedish Export Credit Corporation (SEK), a Swedish state-owned export credit lender, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its interim report for January-September 2026, the US-equivalent current report for a foreign private issuer. No transaction is announced. Reported figures include 9M net interest income of Skr 2,104 million versus Skr 2,050 million, operating profit of Skr 1,618 million versus Skr 1,459 million, after-tax return on equity of 7.0 percent, total capital ratio of 23.8 percent, and total assets of Skr 353.8 billion. This is routine periodic financial disclosure, not a special situation.
